---
title: "Compare Genes Across Dementia Transitions"
params:
  top_n: 1000
editor_options: 
  chunk_output_type: console
---

## Load Packages

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| message: false
#| warning: false

pacman::p_load(ComplexUpset, install = FALSE)

conflicted::conflict_prefer_all("dplyr", quiet = TRUE)
```

## Load Data

### Set the top number of genes

```{r}
#| label: set-top-number
#| message: false

# top_n <- 1000
```

### Get File Paths

```{r}
#| label: get-paths
#| message: false

source(here("custom_func/select_top_cg.R"))
annot <- read_rds(here("data/upon_request/annotated_asso_wide.rds"))

# Dementia transition categories (alphabetical, matching the legacy file order)
demcats <- c("mci2incid", "normal2incid", "normal2mci", "prev", "stable_mci") |>
  set_names()

demcats
```


### Create a function to process each file

```{r}
#| output: false

# Make a function to process each demcat's top CpG sites
process_file <- function(top_cg) {
  top_cg |>
    select(cg, great_anno) |>
    separate_longer_delim(great_anno, delim = stringr::regex(" |, ", ignore_case = TRUE)) |>
    # Remove the rows like (+83228) or (-299) or (0)
    filter(!str_detect(great_anno, "\\(\\+\\d+|\\-\\d+|\\(0\\)")) |>
    rename(genes = great_anno)
}

# Test the function
process_file(select_top_cg(annot, "normal2mci", params$top_n))
```

### Process all files

```{r}
#| label: process-all-files
#| message: false

all_genes_df <- demcats |>
  map_dfr(~ process_file(select_top_cg(annot, .x, params$top_n)), .id = "condition")

glimpse(all_genes_df)
```

## Gene number per condition

```{r}
#| label: gene-number-per-condition
#| fig.width: 8
#| fig.height: 6

all_genes_df |>
  group_by(condition) |>
  summarise(n_genes = n_distinct(genes)) |>
  arrange(desc(n_genes)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = n_genes, y = reorder(condition, n_genes))) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = format(n_genes, big.mark = ",")), 
    vjust = 0, 
    hjust = -0.1, 
    size = 5
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of Genes",
    y = "Condition",
    title = glue("Gene Counts per Condition (Top {params$top_n} CpGs)")
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


## Create UpSet Plot

```{r}
#| label: upset-plot
#| fig.width: 12
#| fig.height: 10

upset_plot <- all_genes_df |> 
  select(genes, condition) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  mutate(presence = 1) |>
  pivot_wider(id_cols = genes, names_from = condition, values_from = presence, values_fill = 0) |> 
  upset(
    intersect = c("normal2mci", "stable_mci", "normal2incid", "mci2incid", "prev"),
    name = "Dementia Transitions",
    width_ratio=0.2,
    min_size = 110,
    wrap=TRUE,
    encode_sets=FALSE,  
    matrix = intersection_matrix( geom = geom_point(size = 1)),
    set_sizes= upset_set_size()
        + geom_text(aes(label=after_stat(count) %>% format(big.mark = ",")), hjust=1.05, stat='count', size = 6 / .pt)
        # Use 2000 for top 1000, and 3500 for top 2000
        + scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 3, trans = "reverse", expand = expansion(mult = c(1.0, 0)))
        + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=30)),
    base_annotations=list(
        'Intersection size'=intersection_size(
            text_colors=c(on_background='black', on_bar='white'),
            text = list(size = 6 / .pt, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = -0.3)
        ) +
        labs(y = "Intersection")),
    themes=upset_default_themes(panel.grid=element_blank(), axis.text=element_text(size=6), axis.title=element_text(size=8))
    # themes=list(default=theme(panel.grid =element_blank(), panel.background = element_blank(), panel.border = element_blank()))
  )

upset_plot
```
